With Ouija and Ouija: Origin of Evil attracting renewed attention following their arrival on Netflix this October, horror fans looking for another supernatural scare can discover Ouija Hell House, an independent horror film distributed by Breaking Glass Pictures.

Blending Ouija-board mythology, paranormal activity, and haunted-house suspense, Ouija Hell House follows a single mother who moves with her daughters into a secluded farmhouse in hopes of starting over. Their fresh beginning takes a terrifying turn when they discover an old Ouija board inside the house, unleashing a sinister presence that threatens their safety.

As unexplained disturbances escalate, the family finds itself confronting something far more dangerous than an ordinary haunted house. The film explores one of horror’s most enduring fears: what happens when someone attempts to contact the other side and something answers?

A New Destination for Fans of Ouija Horror

The renewed visibility of Ouija-themed films this Halloween season presents an opportunity for audiences to explore more supernatural horror stories. For viewers searching for Ouija-board horror, haunted-house nightmares, and films about families facing unexplained evil, Ouija Hell House offers an independent story built around these familiar genre favorites.

By combining the ominous symbolism of the Ouija board with the claustrophobic setting of an isolated farmhouse, the film delivers a chilling premise for fans of paranormal and supernatural horror.

“Ouija Hell House” is available through Breaking Glass Pictures. Horror fans can visit the film’s title page for additional information and viewing options.
